system.description:
You can spend a Force Point as a Standard Action to become immune to detection by The Force for 1 hour. During this time, you always avoid detection by characters who are using the Sense Force application of the Use the Force skill, and you cannot be the target of the Farseeing Force Power.

You may use this as a Reaction to another character attempting to locate you with Sense Force (but before the character locates you). If you make a Use the Force check, this Talent's effect immediately ends.
